decision: Tested Size control scales art at one anchor; tested Fill repaints existing connected terrain and does not append on the selected empty click. Neither operation establishes owner-requested geographical site footprint or non-destructive region completion. Keep these separate product acceptance outcomes; no unsupported absence/uniqueness claim.
